headline: ISP dodged spike charges, matching the best possible transit bill.
text: ISP pays two providers billed on their busiest samples, and TinyInc's traffic to Remote spiked fivefold every few days. ISP kept baseline on Cheap and shuffled spikes between Expensive and Cheap so each spike fell in the samples each provider discards. The bill came to $102, the best possible in hindsight, versus $511 if nothing had changed.
